obituaries.full_text:
CARNEY: At his home in Cheswold on April 23, 
1966
. (Ted) Clement Jr. husband of Mrs. Henrietta Carney of Cheswold. Age 66 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend the funeral services at the Matthews Funeral Home, 55  W. Commerce St., Smyrna, Del, on Wednesday afternoon, April 27, at 2 o'clock. Internment in Emanuel Union Methodist Cemetary in Cheswold. Viewing at his late residence in Cheswold on Tuesday evening from 7-9 PM

Clement Carney Sr. 
(no date noted)
